# claude-keep-going

> Zero-dependency CLI that keeps unattended Claude Code sessions going. When a
> subscription usage/session limit hits ("You've hit your session limit · resets 2am"),
> it waits until the reset and sends "continue", letting Claude Code's own
> auto-continue go first when hooks are installed. Sustained API overload
> (`API Error: 529 … overloaded_error`, 500/502/503/504) gets exponential backoff with
> jitter; safeguard/AUP false positives get a bounded re-send; a stream truncated by a
> suspend or dropped connection is resumed. Opt-in: idle compaction (`/compact` shortly
> before the prompt cache expires, or when the session runs `claude-keep-going request
> compact`) and weekly-limit model fallback ("You've hit your Opus limit" → `/model
> sonnet`, and back after the reset). tmux-based, so it keeps working after you
> disconnect.

Install: `npm i -g claude-keep-going && claude-keep-going install` — then use `claude`
as usual.

Key facts:

- Detects the real Claude Code renders verbatim: `5-hour limit reached - resets 3pm`,
  `You've hit your session limit · resets 2am (Europe/Zurich)`, `Claude usage limit
  reached`, `You're out of extra usage`, `API Error: 529 {"type":"overloaded_error"…}`,
  `API Error: Server is temporarily limiting requests (not your usage limit)`,
  `<model>'s safeguards flagged this message`, `API Error: Your computer went to
  sleep mid-response`.
- Navigates the `/rate-limit-options` menu to "Stop and wait for limit to reset"
  across any menu layout; never confirms "Upgrade your plan".
- Safe by design: verifies Claude is the foreground process before injecting keys,
  stops the moment the user (or Claude) resumes, and detection is anchored to the live
  pane tail so quoted errors in scrollback can't trigger a retry.
- Timezone- and DST-aware reset-time parsing; `--print` mode supported; optional
  config at `~/.config/claude-keep-going/config.json` (XDG) with safe fallbacks for invalid values.
- No runtime dependencies; Node >= 18; MIT license; about 700 tests. A Nix flake with
  NixOS and home-manager modules is included.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/someonewithpc/claude-keep-going/blob/main/README.md): features, configuration, every error render detected
- [DESIGN-NOTES](https://github.com/someonewithpc/claude-keep-going/blob/main/DESIGN-NOTES.md): upstream architecture notes — StopFailure hook event channel vs. terminal scraper, overload backoff design
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/someonewithpc/claude-keep-going/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history

## Install for a user (agent-friendly, non-interactive)

- `npm install -g claude-keep-going`
- `claude-keep-going install --yes` — shell wrapper (+ tmux if missing), migrates files from an older install; takes effect in new shells
- `claude-keep-going install-hook` — recommended: API-error and turn-state hooks; needed for compaction, native defer and model-fallback switch-back
- Optional: `claude-keep-going install-timer`, and prefix the user's `statusLine.command` with `claude-keep-going statusline-tap -- `
- Verify: `claude-keep-going logs`
- Remove: `uninstall-hook`, `uninstall-timer`, `uninstall`, then `npm uninstall -g claude-keep-going`, and drop the `statusline-tap -- ` prefix (see the README's Uninstall section)
